description: This University of Freiburg archive supplies the primary validation data and Python analysis code for the AccRo flood-model paper. It supports comparison of flood-depth, velocity and discharge estimates with the study reference calculations. The linked experiments include synthetic hillslope and channel cases and the roughly three-square-kilometre Riedgraben catchment in southwestern Germany. These are event experiments, not a continuous observational record. The study uses two-metre grids for AccRo and RIM2D, but individual archived layer resolutions were not checked. The public ZIP package is free under MIT and can help evaluate modelling choices for pluvial exposure around buildings and drainage assets. A limitation is that the registry gives no detailed file inventory or complete internal format specification. Python scripts are explicitly identified, while raster and tabular content is inferred from the described validation products. The AccRo code has a separate resource DOI. No directly related catalogue dataset was found, and the data package was not downloaded or the comparison rerun.
